name: GroupManager
author: unknown
description: Provides on-the-fly system for permissions system created by Nijikokun. 权限加载于内存并定时保存至文件 汉化 尘曲.

commands.name: manuadd
commands.description: 移动玩家到指定组. (如果不存在会添加至文件)

commands.name: manudel
commands.description: 移除指定玩家的配置文件, 并移动到默认组.

commands.name: manuaddsub
commands.description: 移动玩家到子组.

commands.name: manudelsub
commands.description: 将玩家从子组中移出.

commands.name: mangadd
commands.description: 增加一个权限组.

commands.name: mangdel
commands.description: 移除一个权限组, 玩家会被移动到默认组

commands.name: manuaddp
commands.description: 为玩家增加权限.

commands.name: manudelp
commands.description: 为玩家移除权限.

commands.name: manuclearp
commands.description: 移除指定玩家所有权限.

commands.name: manulistp
commands.description: 列出玩家全部权限.

commands.name: manucheckp
commands.description: 检查玩家是否具有权限并查看来源.

commands.name: mangaddp
commands.description: 为组增加权限.

commands.name: mangdelp
commands.description: 为组移除权限.

commands.name: mangclearp
commands.description: 移除权限组全部权限.

commands.name: manglistp
commands.description: 列出权限组全部权限.

commands.name: mangcheckp
commands.description: 检查权限组是否具有权限并查看来源.

commands.name: mangaddi
commands.description: 添加组1到组2的继承列表.

commands.name: mangdeli
commands.description: 将组1从组2的继承列表中移除.

commands.name: manuaddv
commands.description: 添加/替换玩家的变量. 目前支持 prefix 和 suffix.

commands.name: manudelv
commands.description: 移除玩家的变量.

commands.name: manulistv
commands.description: 列出玩家的全部变量.

commands.name: manucheckv
commands.description: 查询玩家是否具有变量并查看来源.

commands.name: mangaddv
commands.description: 添加/替换组的变量. 目前支持 prefix 和 suffix.

commands.name: mangdelv
commands.description: 移除组的变量.

commands.name: manglistv
commands.description: 列出组的全部变量

commands.name: mangcheckv
commands.description: 查询组是否具有变量并查看来源.

commands.name: manwhois
commands.description: 查看玩家属于何组

commands.name: tempadd
commands.description: 为玩家创建一个临时权限拷贝.

commands.name: tempdel
commands.description: 移除玩家的临时权限拷贝.

commands.name: templist
commands.description: 列出使用/tempadd进入超载权限模式下的玩家 .

commands.name: tempdelall
commands.description: 移除所有使用 /tempadd 进入超载模式的玩家.

commands.name: mansave
commands.description: 保存权限至文件.

commands.name: manload
commands.description: 重载当前世界和配置文件. 或重载指定世界.

commands.name: listgroups
commands.description: 列出可用组.

commands.name: manpromote
commands.description: 提升同一继承组的玩家到更高级别.

commands.name: mandemote
commands.description: 降低同一继承组的玩家到更低级别.

commands.name: mantogglevalidate
commands.description: 开启/关闭在线验证.

commands.name: mantogglesave
commands.description: 开启/关闭自动保存.

commands.name: manworld
commands.description: 查看已选世界名称

commands.name: manselect
commands.description: 选择一个世界以进行后续指令.

commands.name: manclear
commands.description: 清空所选世界, 指令将作用在当前世界.

commands.name: mancheckw
commands.description: 查看权限文件保存路径.
